Tune the triggers of hcr_effort() to a risk criterion

Source: R/tune_rules.R
ms_tune_hcr.Rd

Runs a grid of effort-rule triggers (and closure triggers, if close is given) in one vectorised call with common random numbers: every grid point sees the same process and assessment errors. The tuned rule maximises the objective among the grid points that meet the risk limit.

Usage

ms_tune_hcr(
  sys,
  triggers = seq(0.5, 1.2, by = 0.05),
  close = NULL,
  close_triggers = NULL,
  risk = c(worst_P_below_Bpa = 0.05),
  objective = "yield",
  E_ref,
  B_init,
  E_init = E_ref,
  nsim = 200,
  years = 50,
  eval_years = 31:50,
  seed = 1,
  Blim = 0.25,
  assess_cv = 0.2,
  max_change = Inf,
  Emin = 0.1,
  assessed = NULL,
  assign = NULL,
  complexes = NULL,
  complex_index = "biomass",
  aggregate = "weighted",
  own_q = 0.5,
  ...
)

Arguments

sys

an ms_system.

triggers

effort-rule triggers (B/Bmsy)

close

stock or complex protected by a closure (see hcr_effort()).

close_triggers

closure triggers; NULL = same as the effort trigger

risk

named limit on a perf_rows() column, e.g. c(worst_P_below_Bpa = 0.05) (every stock below Bpa at most 5% of the time) or c(worst_P_assessed = 0.05) (only the assessed stocks)

objective

perf_rows() column to maximise ("yield" or "profit")

E_ref

reference days by segment (the caps the rule scales), e.g. the safeguarded-MMSY effort from ms_optimise() or the status-quo days

B_init, E_init

initial biomass and days (the status quo).

nsim, years, eval_years, seed

simulations, years, years evaluated, seed.

Blim, assess_cv, max_change, Emin, complexes, complex_index, assign, aggregate, own_q

passed to hcr_effort().

assessed

stocks with an assessment (default all)

...

passed to ms_simulate() (gamma, capacity, proc_cv, ...)

Value

A list with table (performance by grid point), best (the tuned triggers) and the criteria.
